decision_question: Should the council vertical slice ship as a duo-mode-only capability first?

positions.stance: ship duo first — a full protocol built without a live duo slice is an unexamined assumption

INFERENCE: duo exercises every authority boundary the full panel does, at one ninth the seat count
ASSUMPTION: a later full-mode expansion will not need contract changes
UNKNOWN: whether quick and triad share a quorum floor

positions.confidence_basis: every claimed authority boundary is testable in duo mode
known_limitations: cannot observe multi-seat dissent dynamics present only in larger panels

positions.stance: build full protocol first — duo under-exercises the anonymized cross-examination stage

FACT: the full mode adds an anonymized Round 2 that duo abbreviates
INFERENCE: cross-examination is where leak and suppression defects surface
UNKNOWN: actual defect rate difference between abbreviated and full exchange

known_limitations: higher cost and longer feedback loop before any observable behavior

consensus.explanation: Split verdict: neither option cleared the weighted threshold. The round budget is spent; the dilemma is escalated to the orchestrator/operator. No extra round was run.

acceptable_compromises: duo slice ships with its abbreviated exchange stage explicitly labeled a protocol deviation
full-mode cross-examination is covered by deterministic fixture tests before any live full session

kill_criteria.condition: duo slice review finds a leak path that fixture tests did not cover
kill_criteria.action_on_trigger: halt council workstream; revert to direct-answer workflow

concrete_next_step.object: Phase C duo vertical slice implementation

unresolved_questions: whether quick and triad share a quorum floor (UNKNOWN in both positions)
actual defect rate difference between abbreviated and full exchange (UNKNOWN in s2)

dissent.minority_report: s2 maintains that shipping duo first risks certifying an exchange stage that has never been adversarially exercised; s1 maintains that an unshipped full protocol certifies nothing at all.
points_of_disagreement: whether stage coverage or feedback loop length dominates risk

synthesis_notes: Chairman (noesis-quill, excluded from panel) synthesized positions; both positions recorded verbatim before release and are immutable in this artifact.
